item.title: Enes Eken — 研究者分析报告
item.description: Enes Eken: Enes Eken’s academic career shows a clear three-stage evolution. The first stage (2014–2018) focused on the reliability design of Spin Transfer Torque RAM (STT-RAM). item.description: This week, across three devices—DCC, Tianhe Supercomputing, and TzJsDesktop—four main projects were advanced in parallel: space transcriptome research, robot operation training/assessment, AI personal assistant, and paper management tools. The MIHD project completed the full set of fusion experiments for scGPT+UNI2 (QFormer avg ARI=0.370, +117% vs scGPT-only) and established a zero-shot cross-sample assessment framework; Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning achieved a total success rate of 58.9%, fully surpassing BC-RNN (0%), thereby quantitatively validating the advantages of the VLA model; CalendarPro achieved a structural leap from passive response to active decision-making (321 tests all passed), while exposing and fixing critical integration defects such as the BackgroundCoordinator never starting; gadget Research Scout was built from scratch to production-ready, completing a two-stage LLM paper evaluation pipeline in a single day and providing three research direction suggestions for the first time; error_recovery_benchmark completed the full cleanup of 65 symlinks and the infrastructure for visualizing error scenarios in MP4 format. The most important engineering experience this week is: test passing ≠ system availability (the integration layer must be verified independently), and before designing an agentic system, it is necessary to actively study the architectural patterns of mature similar projects.

item.title: LLM Study
item.description:
Part ChatGPT 4o

ChatGPT 4o API demo

from openai import OpenAI
model_use = "gpt-4o-2024-08-06"
client = OpenAI(api_key="Your-API-key")
completion = client.beta.chat.completions.parse(
	model=model_use,
	messages=[
		{"role": "system", "content": "Extract the event information."},
		{"role": "user", "content": "Alice and Bob are going to a science fair on Friday."},
	],
)
event = completion.choices[0].message.parsed

Note: I tried to use model “gpt-4o” but failed.

How to create ChatGPT API Key

  1. Log in to openai
  2. Use the search bar to search “API keys”
  3. Create a new secret key (Shown only once, invisible after closing the tab)
  4. Go to billing to add some credit to the account
